name: Galactic Fury - VR Space War
summary:
Galactic Fury is an exciting space action game where players travel across the galaxy and fight dangerous enemies in huge space battles. The game takes place in the future, where powerful armies are trying to control planets, space stations, and important resources. Players become brave space commanders who must protect their team, defeat enemy fleets, and bring peace to the galaxy.
